user.title: Portfolio Tracker
user.description:
Creates an empty portfolio. Add stocks, ETFs, or crypto after setup via Configure.

Crypto uses Yahoo symbols, e.g. BTC-USD, ETH-USD, SOL-USD.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Portfolio Tracker is already configured. Use Configure to manage your holdings.

add_holding.title: Add a new holding
add_holding.description:
Enter a Yahoo Finance symbol.

• US stocks / ETFs: NVDA, GOOGL, XLK
• London listings: VUAA.L
• Crypto: BTC-USD, ETH-USD, SOL-USD

Shares and total invested (cost basis) are required.

data.proceeds: Total proceeds ($) — for your own records only

edit_holding_symbol.title: Which stock do you want to edit?

retire_plan.title: Retirement forecast plan
retire_plan.description: Illustrative compound-growth scenarios (4–10 years). Used by ApexCharts and retire sensors. Not financial advice. Leave baseline 0 to use live portfolio value.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Base currency, update schedule preset, and optional fixed snapshot times (09:35, 12:00, 16:05 local).

data.scan_interval: Open-market interval (minutes) — used when schedule is Custom
data.idle_scan_interval: Closed-market interval (minutes) — used when schedule is Custom
